title: Geothermal-Vent & Structural-Relay Counterfactual Dinkelbach Submodular Fusion (H83-GVCD)

preregistered_experiments.description: Single-feature leakage canary audit across all 82 channels (60 label-free physical/geothermal/radiometric/LiDAR + 18 fold-proper visible-network continuation/relay + 4 explicit geothermal-structural coupling channels) on Seed 30 and Seed 20 (gate: symmetric AUC <= 0.90) plus pure physical/geothermal Out-Of-Fold LOQO baseline.

Paired 6-arm dual-seed spatial-quadrant holdout (Seed 30 = 11,342 withheld positives, Seed 20 = 11,321 withheld positives, combined 22,663 withheld positives) at identical 37,654-dot budget comparing A0_random, A1_phys_poisson, A2_struct_poisson, A3_gvcd_poisson, A4_gvcd_dink_c20, and A5_gvcd_dink_c30.

Full-catalogue 4-fold LOQO production surface build, pre-placement surface uniqueness scan, Collar-Decoupled (excl_px=3.0) Quadrant-Calibrated Dinkelbach Submodular 300m Kernel + Uniqueness Cap (0.640 < 0.70) 37,654-dot emission, vendor submission_writer + validate + uniqueness audit.
